# Frontiers

> Frontiers is a leading open access publisher of peer-reviewed scientific articles, enabling researcher collaboration and making science globally accessible through innovative publishing models.

Founded by Henry and Kamila Markram at EPFL in Switzerland, Frontiers operates a researcher-centric publishing platform with multidisciplinary journals, AI-powered quality checks, and institutional partnership agreements. The organization is committed to research integrity, FAIR data management, and advancing open science globally.

## Key Topics

- open-access publishing
- peer-review
